hook.name: FrdmV4LiquidityHook
hook.description: An oracle-based, LP-backed liquidity hook that bypasses the Uniswap v4 AMM curve entirely, executing swaps at FrdmOracle FX rates via BeforeSwapDelta. It manages pool reserves directly using V2-style share accounting, charges a configurable base fee plus per-currency inflation fee, and is UUPS upgradeable behind an ERC1967 proxy.
